title: From 12 Months to 90 Days: VerityX Innovation Labs Sets Out to Rewire How UAE Banks Adopt Fintech
summary:
Banks in the UAE know which problems they want fintechs to solve. What they lack, argues Mark Rothwell-Brooks, is a fast, repeatable way of finding the right partner and proving the solution works.
The post From 12 Months to 90 Days: VerityX Innovation Labs Sets Out to Rewire How UAE Banks Adopt Fintech appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: VerityX Innovation Labs aims to accelerate fintech adoption for banks in the UAE by significantly reducing the time it takes to find partners and prove solutions work. While banks understand their operational challenges, they often lack a fast and repeatable integration process. The new initiative seeks to streamline this journey from twelve months down to ninety days.

title: Meta Pulls Dozens of Porn Ads Linked to Banking Malware After India Warning
summary:
Meta removed at least 39 Facebook and Instagram ads using explicit content to push malicious Android apps like Movexa.apk that steal banking credentials. The takedown followed an Indian government advisory and a Reuters inquiry.
The post Meta Pulls Dozens of Porn Ads Linked to Banking Malware After India Warning appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Meta removed dozens of Facebook and Instagram ads featuring explicit content that were linked to banking malware designed to steal user credentials. The action followed a government advisory from India and a media inquiry, highlighting ongoing security concerns regarding malicious Android applications distributed through major social media advertising platforms.

title: AI Software’s Real Bottleneck is Payments Infrastructure
summary:
Kevin Kidd, founder and CEO of Cresora Commerce, argues that payments infrastructure, not code, now sets the pace of innovation in AI-driven software.
The post AI Software’s Real Bottleneck is Payments Infrastructure appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: According to Kevin Kidd, founder and CEO of Cresora Commerce, payments infrastructure has become the primary bottleneck for innovation in AI-driven software, outpacing the development of the code itself. This highlights a shift in focus for the industry, where transaction systems now determine the overall pace at which artificial intelligence software can advance and scale effectively.
